marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

output.meta_commit_message: feat(gmail): materialize owned archive receipts into mail notes

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Done. Bead `bob-cli-kx.3.1.2` is closed.

**Receipt lifecycle ships.** Owned Gmail archives now materialize into their mail notes: `gmail_archived` carries the newest still-owned receipt's archive time, plus one banner line above the first card stating the archive date and the manual Move-to-Inbox path. A sweep at the end of every live archive path converges notes to the folded journal — set after archive/recovery, clear after let-go, retain on reopen, repair a journal-success/note-write-failure crash with pure-local writes (no Gmail remutation, no new terminal event), and skip unsafe folds without clearing. Dry-run and `-n` write nothing. Untouched `mail.base` files (both known old versions) upgrade to a template with the new Archived by Bob view; customized hubs stay byte-identical.

Files: new [receipt.rs](src/native/gmail/note/receipt.rs) pure projection, sweep + hub upgrade in [archive_apply.rs](src/native/gmail/sync/archive_apply.rs), V2 const + view in [hub.rs](src/native/gmail/note/hub.rs), docs in [gmail.md](docs/gmail.md) and [vault-format.md](docs/reference/vault-format.md).

Verified: 7 receipt + 4 hub unit tests, 4 new integration tests (materialize/clear, reopen-retain, repair, dry-run/`-n`), full `gmail_archive_apply` (34), `gmail_sync` (42), gmail lib (569), preview + shell suites — all green. `fmt` clean on touched files, `just lint` passes. Two pre-existing issues recorded, both reproduced identically on the clean base: `docs-check` reference word budgets (filed as a follow-up note, matching the earlier `bob-cli-l7` pattern) and `fmt` drift in untouched plugin files (left unmodified).

Declaration accepted — commit with bead close submitted.
